Subject: Redwood vendor entry + PO requirements

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We're ready to add Redwood as a vendor in Veridian's AP portal. Before we do the portal entry, procurement needs a short checklist from you so our onboarding team can map PO fields and set up remit instructions. Specifically we need:

- Company legal name as it should appear on PO/invoice
- Tax identifiers for US/EU (EIN and VAT if applicable)
- Remit address(es) and preferred payment rails (ACH, wire, virtual card)
- Sample invoice showing the PO number field you expect and any required line-level metadata (model name, usage period, token count)
- Any contract/PO prerequisites (master services agreement reference, bill-to entity)

Can you send those items and the PDF invoice template you want us to accept? We try to validate fields before provisioning so invoices don't get blocked by PO matching.

Also looping Samir on procure to confirm the portal SLA for activation.

Best,
Elena Martinez
Senior Procurement Manager
Veridian Health

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 16:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor entry + PO requirements

Elena / Samir —

Following up with the attachments I mentioned. A couple clarifications based on common AP mappings:

1) PO matching: We strongly recommend header-level matching on PO number only (and not requiring line-level PO per shipped line) — our billing system emits one invoice per billing period with line-level model usage that references the same PO. If Veridian requires line-level PO referencing, please confirm how you expect the PO to be presented in the CSV/XML import.

2) Tax handling: For US entities we can provide a filled W-9. For EU entities we can provide a VAT self-cert and VAT number where applicable; Ben will confirm VAT registration treatment.

3) Payment days & remittance: Our payment terms default to Net30 unless otherwise agreed in the SOW. Remit instructions are in the packet. We accept ACH (preferred), wire, or virtual card. If you plan to use virtual card, please share the remittance EDI spec or gateway details.

4) Contacts: Please include an AP contact (name + email + AP phone) so we can speed activation and test small invoice acceptance.

Next steps: Once you create the vendor record we'll run a test invoice (under $50) to confirm PO matching and remit routing.

Thanks,
Jonas

Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor entry + PO requirements

Elena / team —

Quick tax and invoice-map notes from FinOps to avoid future holds:

• Please map the invoice header fields exactly as: Invoice Number | Invoice Date | Customer PO Number | Bill-to Name | Bill-to Address | Remit-to Name | Remit-to Account | Total Amount | Tax Amount
• For line items we include: Description, Quantity (hours or units), Unit Price, Extended Cost, model_variant (freeform), usage_period (YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD)
• VAT: If Veridian is in-scope for reverse charge, we send a self-billed invoice. In that case include a VAT code field \"reverse_charge\" and leave Tax Amount = 0; we'll provide the VAT breakdown on our monthly tax report. If you need VAT numeric ID, request our EU VAT cert (we will provide a scanned copy).
• EIN/W-9: I'll attach a quick W-9 for your records (we can do DocuSign if procurement prefers).

I've attached a sample invoice template (XLSX) labeled with the header/line expectations. If your portal uses UBL/Peppol/XML instead, let us know and we can produce an XML sample.

Ben Carter
Head of FinOps, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_sample_invoice_template.xlsx (annotated)
